headline: NNS declares tender offer for OCI unconditional with 67.45% combined stake
summary: NNS declared its acquisition offer for OCI unconditional after 9.95% of shares were tendered. Settlement is scheduled for November 20, bringing NNS and Nassef Sawiris to a 67.45% combined holding.
why: OCI N.V. is a global producer and distributor of nitrogen products and methanol.

impacts.name: OCI N.V.
impacts.why: Declaring an offer unconditional guarantees transaction completion for target shareholders.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Confirmation of a successful tender offer reduces deal uncertainty for target company equity.
